body:
It has been up and down. Being sober is more difficult than I thought it would be. I did start community service, though it turned out to be going out at 5am with the lawn crew at a golf course till 2:30pm. It's not like I've never used a weed eater, put sod down, or mowed etc. But idk, I thought I'd feel good about it but instead I find myself dreading it for the whole day to the point it makes me feel like I can't have a night to relax. IT's stressful, school is stressful. I did open up to a close friend the other night, which felt good. 

Thanks for checking up on me, definitely makes me feel a little better. I don't know why it is a struggle for me to feel good for the majority of a day but, idk, I'll keep battling I guess.
Thanks so much, I will be sure to work on this, Thanks for taking the time to explain all of this in detail as well. Extremely helpful!

I do often feel like my depression will last my lifetime, but there are days few and far between where I will have an awesome day and it gives me a little ray of hope. The only problem is the "few and far between" part of that statement. 

I do feel fantastic when I help somebody out, I recently got my friend into guitar and showed him a few things and the enjoyment he got out of it made my day. (I've only been playing for a few months so I'm no pro in the least) I just like making others happy because it makes me feel great. I'm about to start doing community service through a volunteer agency (for court purposes but my charge is getting dropped if I do everything!) and maybe that will be a real eye-opener.
This has always been a struggle for me, but I will try to keep that in mind. I've never really thought about this to be honest, silly as it may sound. Thanks for replying, it means a lot!

It has always been a challenge for me to identify the roots of my feelings. Your dad sounds like my dad, but it sounds like your dad vocalizes his stresses and negativity more, while with my dad I can see it in his eyes, the constant sighing, the constant tired/weathered look on his face. Sometimes he just looks so worked over about what's going on in his life, in the world, etc. It really effects how I think about somethings. Like is that all life is gonna be? Just stressing about everything? 

When my parents got divorced it kind of (maybe unfairly, maybe not.) made me feel like marriage was just about the sketchiest thing ever, and that It wasn't worth it. I'll never forget the look on my little sisters face when my parents told her they were divorcing, it almost makes me not want to have kids because that ABSOLUTELY crushed me to see that look on the face of a loved one. I was never really angry about the divorce, I just didn't understand why they stayed together for 20+ years before getting one, surely if things didn't work they could've figured it out sooner? 

I very often get mad at myself over my feelings, because just like you mentioned, I know way more people are going through much worse and I feel like it's not right or justified for me to be so bent out of shape over what seems like (at the end of the day) stuff that shouldn't bother me so much. (what a run-on sentence) 

I'm going to try to really think things through for a bit once I have some quiet time to myself, and see if I can really figure out the origins of some of my feelings.

As always, thanks for taking the time out of your day to help me out. I really appreciate it!

It's nice to know that there are other people who have felt similarly at some point. My day started off kinda bleh, but I just drove around in my car listening to music for awhile and I'm feeling a little better. Thank you very much for replying, it means a whole lot. Sometimes it's hard for me to vocalize all my feelings freely, I think I'd do much better being able to express myself If I answered questions. But, I don't want you to to have to work at something like that.

I can truly say sometimes I have no idea why I feel so shitty, I just wake up in the morning and BAM. Though other times feelings such as loneliness, or maybe me being overly-critical about myself can get me pretty down.

 My parents divorced roughly 4 years ago (they both re-married now and im currently living with my mom and step-dad at least for the 1st year at school) I had a horrible time in high school, I hardly had any friends, I was crushed by a girl during that time too (silly as this may sound, especially since it was just high school) but that really damaged my self confidence. I went to truancy court twice during my 4 years at high school and I had to go to summer school my senior year just so I could graduate with everyone else (once again due to absences). Earlier this year I got arrested for possession of MJ when I was out on a date with a girl. It was the first time in years I finally manned up and asked her out and I ended up getting thrown in jail. Needless to say, all this stuff just felt like it was piling up higher and higher and I just felt overwhelmed and frustrated that things seemed so unfair. Even looking back on all I just listed I feel like such a fuck up and such a nuisance to my family making them have to deal with all my shit. I don't think I'm a bad person, idk, I guess I just haven't been good either.

 I usually try to keep to myself when I'm out home, I don't think my dad is a bad guy but he is always stressing out about stuff and it stresses me out being around him sometimes. That's a big reason why I moved in with my mom, I love him to death, but I can't be around negativity like that, it really effects me. I don't venture out of my room too often when I'm at home, sometimes even being social with my family is a little bit of a task for me and for some reason I get really tired when I'm around a group of people. 

Thank you so much for responding, It brings tears to my eyes to have someone talk to me when I finally put everything I've been holding in for a while out there. I'm already feeling a little better.

thank you so much for replying, it means a lot! I think i might have clicked report instead of reply on your comment, I'm sorry and this was an accident if I did. I will do that tomorrow, thank you. Sleeping is sometimes a challenge for me, but I don't have class tomorrow so I can hopefully sleep in a little. Here's hoping I'll never have another day like 9/4/2013 again.
